**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/11/04 (Sat) 15:26
- [EVENT] User is trying to organize their movie collection.
- [EVENT] User purchased the Blu-ray of Avengers: Endgame in July 2019.
- [PREFERENCE] User has a mix of Blu-ray, 4K Ultra HD, and digital copies in their movie collection.
- [FACT] User estimates they have around 50-60 movies in their collection.
- [PREFERENCE] User wants to organize their movies by genre and then alphabetically within each genre.
- [FACT] User currently has their movies scattered across different shelves.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offered to help organize the user's movie collection.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested creating separate sections for each genre and organizing movies alphabetically within those sections.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended using a shelving unit with adjustable shelves or stackable storage cubes for physical copies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised organizing digital copies using folders or playlists on streaming devices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested creating an index or spreadsheet to keep track of the movie collection.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided additional tips for storing and displaying physical copies.
- [PREFERENCE] User decided to organize their physical copies by genre and then alphabetically.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant discussed options for handling franchise movies, specifically the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) movies.
- [PREFERENCE] User chose to create a sub-section within each genre for franchise movies like the MCU.
- [PREFERENCE] User has been watching MCU movies in chronological order lately.
- [EVENT] User is thinking of creating a list of movies they want to watch in the future.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested several methods for keeping track of future movie watchlists, including using Letterboxd, IMDb, spreadsheets, note-taking apps, physical notebooks, movie tracking apps, and Pinterest boards.
- [PREFERENCE] User decided to try out Letterboxd to track their movie watching habits.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant encouraged user to log their rewatch of Avengers: Endgame on Letterboxd and share their thoughts with the community.
